title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2607.05291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on large collections of series and forecast a new series without being trained on it. We compare nine TSFMs, used in this zero-shot setting, with eight econometric models, including the Heterogeneous Autoregressive (HAR) family. We forecast the realized volatility of 50 assets in equities, currencies and futures from the VOLARE dataset one, five and 22 days ahead, and compare the forecasts with pairwise and multi-model tests. The foundation models do not outperform the econometric benchmarks as a class. Only Tiny Time Mixers (TTM), the smallest of them, has a lower average QLIKE loss than the logarithmic HAR (Log-HAR) at every tested horizon, by a narrow margin. For most assets, the Model Confidence Set (MCS) contains TTM together with Log-HAR and several other models. translated_title: 基于时间序列基础模型预测已实现波动率：与计量经济学基准的比较
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型在大规模序列集合上进行预训练，能够在未经专门训练的情况下对新序列进行预测。我们将九个在此零样本设置下使用的时间序列基础模型与八个计量经济学模型（包括异质自回归HAR模型家族）进行比较。我们对来自VOLARE数据集的50个资产（涵盖股票、货币和期货）的已实现波动率进行了提前1天、5天和22天的预测，并通过两两比较和多模型检验对预测结果进行评估。总体而言，基础模型作为一个类别并未超越计量经济学基准模型。其中只有体积最小的Tiny Time Mixers（TTM）在所有测试预测期限上的平均QLIKE损失以微弱优势低于对数HAR（Log-HAR）。对于大多数资产，模型置信集（MCS）中同时包含TTM、Log-HAR以及其他几个模型。不同基础模型之间的预测精度差异远大于其中最优模型与Log-HAR之间的差异，因此选择何种基础模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 时间序列基础模型在零样本预测已实现波动率时整体上并未超越传统计量经济学模型，仅最小的TTM模型以微弱优势胜过Log-HAR基准。
en_tdlr: Time series foundation models in zero-shot settings do not outperform econometric benchmarks as a class for realized volatility forecasting, with only the smallest model (TTM) narrowly beating Log-HAR.
